name: app-shell
title: App shell
description: Header frame (navigation toggle, breadcrumb, actions), a sidebar, the page and an aside, one gutter apart; the sidebar is a full-height column that can collapse to a rail; below a width of its own the sidebar and aside become sheets.
whenToUse: Use it as the frame of an application: header, sidebar, page and an optional aside that fold into sheets as its own width shrinks. For one region of a screen use Panel.

parts.name: AppShell
parts.description: The page around a product's screens: a header frame, the sidebar, the page, and an optional aside, built from the parts above (AppShellRoot, AppShellHeader with AppShellToggle, AppShellCrumbs and AppShellActions, AppShellNav, AppShellMain, AppShellAside). ┌──┬──────────────────────────────────────────────────┬───────┐ │▥ │ Shipments / Rotterdam / SHP-24018 │ acts │ header frame: toggle cell · crumbs · actions └──┴──────────────────────────────────────────────────┴───────┘ ┌────────┐ ┌──────────────────────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ │ Nav │ │ main │ │ aside │ one gutter apart (C1) └────────┘ └──────────────────────────────┘ └──────────────┘ Three layouts, by the shell's own width: - wide (≥ asideInlineAt): sidebar, page and aside side by side. The toggle cell shows and hides the sidebar column (aria-expanded, aria-controls). The sidebar and aside are sticky, one gutter from the top. - medium (≥ narrowAt): the sidebar stays; the aside opens as an end Sheet, so it never crushes the page. - narrow: the sidebar is a start Sheet opened by the same cell and closed by choosing an item; the aside is an end Sheet bound to `asideOpen` (focus moves in, Escape and the scrim close it, focus returns). - The width is the shell's own, so a shell inside a pane or a preview frame decides for itself. CSS lays the columns out by it (a container query), so the server's HTML is already right for the width it lands in; the measurement (ResizeObserver) then decides only which parts become sheets, and moves nothing. - Motion: the sheets unfold from their edge; the wide column toggles without animation (a layout change that moves the page should be immediate).

props.name: actions
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>
props.description: Cells at the header's end. For several commands pass a `<Toolbar layout="cell" overflow="menu">`: it is one Tab stop, and when the header narrows the crumbs give up room first, then the toolbar's last items move into More.

props.name: aside
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>
props.description: Contextual panel at the end (an Inspector). Shown while `asideOpen`.

props.name: asideFinalFocus
props.type: boolean | RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | ((closeType: InteractionType) => boolean | void | HTMLElement | null)
props.description: Where focus goes when the aside's sheet closes (AppShellAside's finalFocus).

props.name: asideInlineAt
props.description: The aside sits beside the page only from this shell width (default narrowAt + 440: room for the sidebar, the aside and a page still worth reading). Between narrowAt and this, the sidebar stays and the aside opens as a sheet, so opening it never crushes the page.

props.name: asideLabel
props.description: Names the aside's sheet on narrow layouts.

props.name: asideOpen
props.description: Whether the aside (AppShellAside) is shown: beside the page where there is room, else as an end sheet.

props.name: children
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>

props.name: collapse
props.description: Wide layout: what closing the sidebar does. "hide" (default) removes the column; "rail" keeps a narrow column of the Nav's key cells (items need `icon`), with each label as a tooltip on hover and focus.

props.name: container
props.description: Portal container for the sheets (the keyline scope travels with them either way).

props.name: header
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>
props.description: Header content after the toggle cell: usually <Breadcrumb layout="cell" …/>.

props.name: mainProps
props.description: Props for the <main> element (AppShellMain).

props.name: narrowAt
props.description: Below this width of the shell itself (not the viewport), the sidebar and aside become sheets. Default 960.

props.name: nav
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>
props.description: The sidebar: usually <Nav layout="cell" …/>.

props.name: navLabel
props.description: Names the sidebar: the toggle cell says "Show <navLabel>", the narrow sheet is called this.

props.name: navOpen
props.description: Wide layout: whether the sidebar column is shown. Controlled or not (default open).

props.name: navSize
props.description: Wide-layout widths of the sidebar and the inline aside (any CSS length; numbers are px). Defaults 15rem and 22rem.

props.name: onAsideOpenChange
props.description: Called when the aside's sheet asks to close (Escape, the scrim), with Base UI's eventDetails.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Keep the header in view while the page scrolls. The sidebar and aside then sit one gutter below it and never move: the page scrolls past a fixed frame. The header sticks at --kl-shell-top (default one gutter; set it to where the shell starts on the page, so nothing shifts on the first scroll), and the columns leave the same room at the bottom.

parts.name: AppShellActions
parts.description: Cells at the header's end. For several commands put a `<Toolbar layout="cell" overflow="menu">` here: it is one Tab stop, and when the header narrows the crumbs give up room first, then the toolbar's last items move into More.

parts.name: AppShellAside
parts.description: A contextual panel at the end (an Inspector), shown while the root's `asideOpen`: beside the page from asideInlineAt, an end sheet below it (focus moves in, Escape and the scrim close it, focus returns). `className`, `style` and `render` reach the column.

props.name: finalFocus
props.type: boolean | RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | ((closeType: InteractionType) => boolean | void | HTMLElement | null)
props.description: Where focus goes when the aside's sheet closes (Base UI finalFocus). The sheet is opened by state, not by a trigger, so pass the control that opened it (a ref): WebKit does not focus a button on click, and without this focus would fall back to whatever was focused before.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the aside's sheet on narrow and medium layouts. Default "Details".

parts.name: AppShellCrumbs
parts.description: The header's content after the toggle, taking the rest of the row: usually a <Breadcrumb layout="cell" />.

parts.name: AppShellHeader
parts.description: The header frame: a row of cells across the top (AppShellToggle, AppShellCrumbs, AppShellActions).

parts.name: AppShellMain
parts.description: The page: a <main> landmark in the shell's middle column.

parts.name: AppShellNav
parts.description: The sidebar: usually a <Nav layout="cell" />. Wide and medium, a sticky column the toggle shows and hides (or collapses to a rail); narrow, a start sheet the toggle opens, closed by choosing a place. `className`, `style` and `render` reach the column.

parts.name: AppShellRoot
parts.description: The shell's root: the grid, the width it measures, and the sidebar's state. Holds AppShellHeader, AppShellNav, AppShellMain and AppShellAside as direct children.

parts.name: AppShellToggle
parts.description: The header's first cell: shows and hides the sidebar column (wide), collapses it to its rail (collapse="rail"), or opens the start sheet (narrow). Named from the root's navLabel; its glyph is the default children.
